name: AboveWP Page Loader
author: AboveWP

sections.description:
AboveWP Page Loader adds a beautiful, customizable loading screen to your WordPress website. The loader appears when visitors navigate to your site and smoothly fades out once the page has loaded, creating a polished and professional user experience.

Features

  • Sleek, modern loading animation
  • Multiple animation options:
    • Default spinner
    • Animated SVGs
    • Custom images (including GIFs)
  • Displays your site logo or site name during loading
  • Smooth fade-out transition when the page is ready
  • Customizable colors to match your brand
  • Adjustable animation size, duration, and delay settings
  • Smooth page transitions between internal links
  • Responsive design that works on all devices
  • Lightweight with minimal impact on page performance

Usage

After activation, the page loader will automatically appear on your website. You can customize the following settings:

  • Enable/Disable: Turn the page loader on or off
  • Animation Type: Choose between spinner, SVG, or custom image
  • Animation Size: Set the size of your animation
  • Animation Duration: Set how long the fade-out animation lasts
  • Delay Before Hiding: Set how long to wait before hiding the loader after the page loads
  • Loader Color: Choose a color that matches your brand (for spinner animation)

Using SVG Animations

  1. Select “Animated SVG” as your animation type
  2. Upload an SVG file or enter the URL to an SVG file
    • For best results, use an SVG with built-in animations

Using Custom Images

  1. Select “Custom Image” as your animation type
  2. Upload an image or enter the URL to an image file
    • Animated GIFs work great for this option

sections.installation:
1. Upload the abovewp-page-loader folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Page Loader to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Will this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, AboveWP Page Loader is designed to be compatible with any WordPress theme.

Does this slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. The loader actually improves perceived performance by providing visual feedback during page loading.

Can I customize the loader animation?

Yes! You can choose between a spinner, SVG, or custom image. Each option has its own customization settings.
